releases.name: Release Browser & Documentation Organization
releases.commitMessage:
feat: Release v0.2.1 - Release Browser & Documentation Organization

Features:
- Release Browser with search functionality
- Browse all previous releases interactively
- Search through features, bug fixes, and keywords
- Navigate between releases with prev/next controls
- Enhanced release notes modal with 'Browse All Releases' button

Documentation Organization:
- Created /docs folder structure
- Release-specific docs in /docs/releases/vX.Y.Z/
- General guides in /docs/guides/
- Added INDEX.md for easy navigation
- README.md in each release folder

Technical:
- Created ReleaseBrowser component
- Enhanced ReleaseNotes utility
- Added global browseReleases() function
- Search indexing across all releases
- Statistics display (total releases, features)

Files Reorganized:
- Moved all implementation docs to appropriate release folders
- v0.1.0 docs: ACTORS_*, SCENE_*
- v0.2.0 docs: CAST_GRID_*
- Guides: RELEASE_*, VERSION_*, SVG_*, etc.

This makes it easy to:
- Find documentation for any release
- Search across all release history
- Browse releases chronologically
- Access version-specific implementation details
features: Release Browser - Browse all previous releases
Release Viewer UI with navigation controls
Release Search - Search through all releases

releases.name: Cast Grid Feature
releases.commitMessage:
feat: Complete Cast Grid feature v0.2.0

Phases 4-8 Implementation:
- Phase 4: Detail screen with prev/next navigation, keyboard shortcuts, URL state
- Phase 5: Mobile responsive with touch swipe, tap targets, breakpoints
- Phase 6: Quick add with photo upload (URL + file picker with preview)
- Phase 7: Toast notifications, enhanced animations, error handling
- Phase 8: Complete documentation and version bump

New Features:
- Actor detail screen with grid navigation (prev/next through filtered list)
- Keyboard shortcuts: ← → for navigation, ESC for back
- Touch swipe navigation on mobile/iPad
- Toast notification system for user feedback
- Photo upload in quick add (URL or file with preview)
- Comprehensive error handling with retry
- Enhanced hover/focus animations
- Mobile responsive throughout

Files Added:
- actors-detail.html (detail view)
- actors-detail.js (detail controller)
- actors-detail.css (detail styles)
- toast.js (notification utility)
- toast.css (notification styles)
- CAST_GRID_COMPLETE.md (full documentation)

Files Modified:
- actors.html (added photo upload to quick add)
- actors-grid.js (toast integration, photo handling)
- actors-grid.css (enhanced mobile responsive, animations)
- version.js (bumped to 0.2.0)
- package.json (bumped to 0.2.0)

Ready for testing on iPad and mobile devices.
features: Sort actors by name, scene count, or recently added

bugfixes: Fixed viewport meta tag typo in actors.html

Fixed photo preview not clearing on modal close

releases.name: Initial Release with Version System
releases.commitMessage:
Initial release with semantic versioning system.

Added:
- Semantic versioning system (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
- version.js module with centralized version control
- Version badge display on all pages
- VERSION_GUIDE.md documentation

Initial Features:
- Base continuity management system
- Project and scene management
- Actor management (original list view)
- Location management
- Settings and conditions
- Calendar integration with Toast UI
- SVG-based silhouette system
- User authentication with Supabase
- Role-based permissions (admin/user)

Technical:
- Vanilla JavaScript ES6 modules
- DaisyUI + Tailwind CSS
- Supabase backend (PostgreSQL + Auth)
- SortableJS for drag-and-drop
- Toast UI Calendar
